scope: Compact canonical geography codec resolving the M7 review condition C1: the 16 KiB transports carry the full DungeonLevel in GeographyFacts, whose natural JSON reached 15.4-17.4 KiB on fresh levels (measured over seeds 1-200), so over-bound worlds refused every geography-reading action with the state untouched. The codec encodes the tile grid as one byte per cell inside a hex string with a small branch-stairs side table; rooms, stairs, engravings, traps and flags keep their natural (already compact, coordinate-sorted) encodings. The wire is lossless and canonical: deserializing and re-serializing reproduces the exact same bytes, which the owner decode path requires. Kernel limits unchanged.
source_digest_method: sha256 over the sha256sum lines of every non-docs source file tracked at commit time (git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard, excluding docs/), sorted by path: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard | grep -zv '^docs/' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum

resolution.codec: crates/nethacked-dungeon/src/compact.rs: pub mod compact_level with serialize/deserialize for serde with; wire = JSON object with fixed 11-field order (v, w, h, tiles hex 1 byte/cell, branch_levels hex side table, rooms, stairs_up, stairs_down, engravings sorted (Coord, V) pairs, traps sorted (Coord, V) pairs, is_dark, no_teleport); tile variants 0-14 with payload nibbles (door state bits 0-1 + trapped bit 2, alignment 2 bits, branch id full nibble, wall/door/pit/drawbridge/pool flags); no new dependencies
resolution.transports: All 7 non-traversal transports (action_time, movement_actions, inventory_actions, item_effects, services, monster_ticks, timer_ticks) carry #[serde(with = "nethacked_dungeon::compact_level")] on GeographyFacts.level; the Rust field type stays DungeonLevel so no call sites changed; traversal (I9, 8 MiB) deliberately unchanged
resolution.acceptance: crates/nethacked-sim/src/owner_persistence/runtime/tests/geography_compact.rs (4 tests): lossless + canonical roundtrip across seeds 1-200 (natural-encoding level equality, whole-struct equality, byte-identical re-encode); every-transport roundtrip on a rich level (branch stairs incl. RogueLevel, locked/trapped door, secret door, pit, altars, drawbridge, pool, wall, lava, engravings, traps, vibrating_square/stored_keys); the 16 KiB bound across seeds 1-200 with a 12 KiB margin target and a pin that seeds 1/4/9 were over-bound under the natural encoding; the full 24-step combined script bit-for-bit against the legacy oracle on previously over-bound seed 4 (depth/stored-levels verified)
resolution.m7_audit: m7_geography_payload_boundary rewritten to pin the resolved boundary: compact size <= 16384, Wait+Move dispatch Ok and the world turn advances, for seeds 1-16 (seeds 1/4/9 were 17027/17572/17041 bytes natural); m7_world doc comment updated (any seed fits; the seed only steers terrain)

measurements.margin: compact max is ~4x under the 16384-byte kernel payload bound; per-seed margin target 12288 bytes

limits: 16 KiB kernel payload limits unchanged; no limit raised inside this increment; traversal (I9) 8 MiB unchanged
